title: Immunofluorescence and Confocal Microscopy Protocol
author: Elisabeth Holzer
materials: Treat cells for 02:00:00 with one of the following (as per figure legend): EBSS (Sigma-Aldrich, Cat# E3024- 500 mL ) + 100 nanomolar (nM) Bafilomycin A1 (Santa Cruz Biotechnology, Cat# sc-201550) 2 micromolar (µM) VPS34-IN1 (ApexBio, Cat# APE-B6179)
Incubate cells with primary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer for 02:00:00 at Room temperature .
Incubate with secondary antibodies (1:500 in blocking buffer) for 02:00:00 at Room temperature .

steps.title: Seed cells on coverslips
steps.instruction: Seed 100,000 cells per well onto 12 mm #1.5 glass coverslips (Marienfeld, Cat# 0117520) placed in a 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Incubate overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate the seeded cells overnight at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Fix cells (methanol or PFA)
steps.instruction: Fix cells either with cold methanol for 5 min at –20 °C or with 4 % paraformaldehyde for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash cells once with phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS).

steps.title: Block and permeabilize
steps.instruction: Incubate coverslips for 1 h at room temperature in blocking/permeabilization solution consisting of PBS containing 0.25 % (v/v) Triton X‑100 (Sigma‑Aldrich, Cat# T8787) and 5 % (v/v) BSA (Sigma‑Aldrich, Cat# A9647).

steps.title: Wash 3× with PBS (first)
steps.instruction: Wash the coverslips three times with PBS.

steps.title: Wash 3× with PBS (second)
steps.instruction: Wash the coverslips three times again with PBS.

steps.title: Mount coverslips with DAPI Fluoromount-G
steps.instruction: Mount each coverslip onto a glass microscopy slide using DAPI Fluoromount‑G® (Southern Biotech, Cat# 0100‑20).

steps.title: Store slides at -20 °C
steps.instruction: Store the mounted slides at –20 °C until imaging.

steps.title: Acquire confocal images
steps.instruction: Acquire confocal images on a Zeiss LSM900 equipped with Airyscan 2, using a Plan‑Apochromat 63×/1.4 Oil DIC objective (working distance 0.19 mm).

steps.title: Process images in Zen Blue
steps.instruction: Process the acquired images with the 2D Airyscan processing plug‑in in Zeiss Zen Blue software.
